note: A trimmed export of Spoor's exploration of OWASP Juice Shop, for the product wiki. Spoor's full cache (.spoor-cache/) holds raw captures and is never committed; this keeps only the screens, their controls, the transitions between them, the actions Spoor skipped and why, and per screen the console lines and the REST/API paths requested in the session up to that screen (paths only, no query strings or ids). State ids are shortened to S0, S1, ...; spoor_id is Spoor's own.
tool: spoor explore (ht-spoor), --sandbox against the local test target
